posts.hook: OpenAI's new flagship is cheaper. Whether it is better is still being argued
posts.caption: openai released gpt-6.2 astra and sol, with the flagship priced a fifth lower and early reviews mixed. nvidia's chair said on a record earnings call that the board does not intend to reinstate jensen huang, and sources say banks and the nsa told congress the week's outages came from a rush to patch flaws found by ai models. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, with Astra at ==80%== of the old flagship's price
slides.desc: Early reads are mixed: one index has it flat in coding against the model it replaces.

slides.title: Nvidia's chair, on the record: the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang
slides.desc: Said on a call reporting ==$115.8B== in quarterly revenue, up 103% from a year ago.

slides.title: Sources: the week's outages came from a rush to patch flaws found by AI models
slides.desc: Banks and the NSA told Congress their systems were overwhelmed, the Washington Sun reports.

terms.gloss: the us agency for signals intelligence and code-breaking

slides.title: Java4Shell: a flaw in Java lets attackers run code on servers without logging in
slides.desc: Security startup Calif says it found it with an OpenAI model. Oracle has released a patch.

slides.title: Quad9 is pulling its free DNS resolver out of France after court-ordered daily fines
slides.desc: It cannot notify its users. For hospitals and offices, connections will simply fail.

terms.gloss: the service that turns a site name into the address a device needs

slides.title: California bans Waymo from freeways, and Waymo halts freeway rides nationwide
slides.desc: The order followed a viral video of a robotaxi failing to yield to the highway patrol.

slides.title: Gemini's temporary chats are now kept for about two months, up from 72 hours
slides.desc: The same applies to chats made with history turned off, TechCrunch reports.

posts.hook: Two days, two AI-found holes in the software the internet runs on
posts.caption: security firm xint says it used openai models to find remote code execution flaws in nginx, a day after java4shell, and wiz says it found the same flaws separately. sources say anthropic may price its ipo well above $80 a share, and ula traced its vulcan failure to fuel supply, not the engines. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Xint says OpenAI models found flaws that let attackers run code on ==Nginx== servers
slides.desc: Wiz says it found the same flaws separately. Java4Shell was disclosed the day before.

terms.gloss: web server software that sits in front of a large share of websites

slides.title: Sources: Anthropic may price its IPO ==well above $80==, past its $70 to $78 range
slides.desc: It is also weighing a larger offering as demand surges, CNBC reports.

slides.title: ULA: Vulcan failed because too little fuel reached its engines, not because of the engines
slides.desc: That moves the fault from Blue Origin's BE-4 engines to ULA's own rocket.

terms.gloss: the boeing and lockheed rocket company that builds vulcan

slides.title: Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth, 49 years after launch
slides.desc: 16.094 billion miles: a radio signal now takes a full day to reach it.

slides.title: Documents: Instagram's school safety program was also built to sign up more teens
slides.desc: Internal files call it Project Gryffindor, NPR reports from child safety lawsuits against Meta.

slides.title: OpenAI's models found up to 14% gains in AMD's flagship GPU design in under five months
slides.desc: AMD has already sent some of the changes to manufacturing.

slides.title: Sources: the US may make companies disclose when they use Chinese AI models
slides.desc: Reuters says the aim is to discourage use. ByteDance, meanwhile, seeks OpenAI models via Azure.
